instructions: Class assignment 1 (Modules 1 to 3), set by the Deep Learning faculty.
Marks are not printed on the assignment; each answer is written at the length of a 10-mark exam answer, and short definitions at 5 marks.

questions.label: 1a
questions.text: Explain what are Hidden Units and their purpose in a Neural Network Architecture.

questions.label: 1b
questions.text: Analyze the working of a Feed Forward Neural Network by explaining the role of each layer.

questions.label: 1c
questions.text: Design and solve a Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) for the XOR gate using a suitable example.

questions.label: 1d
questions.text: Analyze the difference between loss function and cost function, and explain how the learning rate affects the training performance of a neural network.

questions.label: 2a
questions.text: Justify the need for regularization and explain how early stopping and dropout achieve regularization.

questions.label: 2b
questions.text: Describe the concept of data augmentation and illustrate its different types with suitable examples.

questions.label: 2c
questions.text: Illustrate the working of AdaGrad, RMSProp, and Adam optimization algorithms with suitable diagrams.

questions.label: 2d
questions.text:
Numerical 1: Calculate the Accuracy and F1-Score for the following classification results. Interpret the calculated values and comment on the effectiveness of the classification model.

| Y_True | 1 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 1 | 1 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Y_Pred | 0 | 0 | 0 | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 |

questions.label: 2e
questions.text:
Numerical 2: Measure the Cross-Entropy Loss for the following data. Show the necessary calculations and interpret the obtained loss value by commenting on the model's prediction performance.

| Y_True | 1 | 1 | 0 | 0 |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Probability | 0.8 | 0.1 | 0.1 | 0.7 |

questions.label: 3a
questions.text: Explain briefly the various applications of Autoencoders and Variational Autoencoders.

questions.label: 3b
questions.text: Analyze the role of latent space visualization in understanding feature representations learned by an autoencoder.

questions.label: 3c
questions.text: Evaluate the effectiveness of Sparse Autoencoders in preventing overfitting in deep learning models.

questions.label: 3d
questions.text: Compare and analyze the working of Sparse, Denoising, and Contractive Autoencoders.
